def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    margin = 1e-4
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]
    mask = diff < 0
    tie_mask = (abs(diff) <= margin) & mask
    valid_mask = mask & (~tie_mask)
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_clamp'})
